verdict.rationale: Latency is a fair question for a real-time voice and video platform, but the evidence pack contains no documented end-to-end latency target, numeric figure, or measured latency path. The only related items are a marketing phrase, "ultra-low latency," about avatar lip-sync and generic real-time monitoring and analytics features. Neither is a documented latency target or path for live conversation.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents an end-to-end latency target or measured latency path suitable for live conversation
